West wing loses cooling, east stays on. If lab freezers on that floor affected, move samples to floor 2 units by Friday EOD (Oct 16). Since user asked summarize and action. I can provide concise bullets.

Should consider whether to mention exact date Friday Oct 16, 2026. Check calendar: Oct 14 2026 Wednesday? Jan31+Feb28+Mar31+Apr30+May31+Jun30+Jul31+Aug31+Sep30 =273, mod7=0, so Oct1 Thursday same as Jan1? 273 mod7=0 yes Thursday. Oct14 Wednesday, Oct17 Saturday, Oct16 Friday. Good.
